name: cart-button

frames.best_why: Shows the clean default cart with two Add pills, one open stepper and the subtotal footer.

tagline: Product list whose Add pills open into quantity steppers and a live total.
summary: A compact cart of three grocery items with an Add button on each row. Pressing Add turns the button into a minus, count and plus, and the subtotal and checkout total update.
appearance: A dark rounded panel lists three items, each with a tinted icon tile, name, price and detail, and a round pill button on the right. A footer row holds the subtotal and a white Checkout button.
behaviour: Pressing Add widens the pill into a minus, quantity and plus; holding either end repeats. The count rolls digit by digit and the subtotal and Checkout sum update, while a limit message appears at the maximum.
demo_content: Grocery items Oat milk, Butter croissant and Cherries with prices and subtotal.
search_phrases: add control that becomes a stepper
quantity picker on a product row
use_when: A short product list needs inline quantity control and a running total without a full cart page.
avoid_when: Item names, prices and icons are baked into the default array, so a real shop must supply its own list.
customise: Pass an items array, starting quantities, currency and a checkout callback; icon tints and layout classes are in the source.
weight_why: Three rows with a few width and roll animations; idle when untouched.

a11y.note: Quantity buttons are labelled, totals are live, and motion honours reduced-motion.

polish_why: Tidy cart rows with a clever rolling count and a clear total.
